survey: A sci-fi control console shown in three-quarter view from the front left. The main body is a light-grey box with rounded edges. It stands flat on a riveted metal floor, and its bottom edge touches the floor along its whole length, with a contact shadow. The top of the box is a dark-grey control panel that slopes down toward the viewer. A raised grey lip runs along the back edge of the top, sitting on the rear wall and spanning its width. On the panel, top left, are two round dial gauges: a white one with a red needle and a green one with a red needle. Each needle is pinned at the centre of its gauge. Below the gauges are eight round push buttons, red and yellow, in two staggered rows of four. Each sits in its own grey bezel and rises from the panel surface, so each could be pressed. On the right is a dark housing with a lengthwise slot. A chrome lever with a red ball knob comes up through the slot from a collar, so it can slide along the slot like a throttle. On the front face is a recessed rectangular door or drawer panel with one horizontal pull handle, set inside the box outline.
